verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages place a 'Comprehensive e-Filing Services' entry under the Apply sections for Designs and Trade Marks and in the Patents e-services rail, next to Track Status. That shows the core filing transaction is offered online. The official fee schedule lists amounts by filing mode, which further supports an online filing channel. Missing for 10: the evidence is mostly navigation labels with no documented walkthrough of the e-filing flow, no explicit evidence of online fee payment, and no independent or hands-on corroboration that a filing can be completed end to end.
